subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source and vendor docs show a real general-vs-Coding-Plan endpoint split, but only maintainer intent plus credentialed testing can decide whether to reroute, diagnose earlier, or keep the split explicit.

options.title: Validate Lite route first
options.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys on Coding Plan
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid for Coding Plan, keep general models separate and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics.

options.title: Support shared key use
options.body: If the same key should work on both endpoints, treat the 401 as a runtime auth/request bug and fix that path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite route first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/Coding Plan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the result.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled-provider setup, and runtime compatibility surfaces where the history is strongest.
